Malaria Importation

Source: R/importation.R
malaria_importation.Rd

Malaria can be imported from outside an area when residents acquire infections while traveling or when infected visitors spend time in the area, get bitten by mosquitoes, and infect them.

For the travel pathway, see travel_malaria. Importation through infectious visitors depends on visitor_availability and visitor_infectiousness.

The importation junction represents these processes using four terms:

time_away

the fraction of time residents spend outside the area

travel_eir

the EIR residents experience while traveling

visitor_availability

the availability of non-resident humans to mosquitoes

visitor_infectiousness

the probability a mosquito becomes infected after feeding on a visitor

These parameters and variables are fully integrated into the interfaces that compute blood feeding, transmission, and exposure. By default, they are set to have no effect, but they can be configured using setup functions.

Note

Importation is called by xds_compute_terms.

There are no terms to model importation by immigrating infected mosquitoes.
